items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against Pflegegrad decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: The letter itself states the delivery rule: 'Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.' No separate posting date is given, so the posting day is the printed Bescheid date, Friday 20.11.2026. Counting the 4 days after posting (posting day not counted): 21.11 (Sat) = day1, 22.11 (Sun) = day2, 23.11 (Mon) = day3, 24.11 (Tue) = day4 -> deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = Tuesday 24.11.2026. The Pflegekasse is a social-law body (like a Krankenkasse), so unlike tax offices the delivery day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday; here it falls on a normal working day anyway. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 355 AO analogue) starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, delivery day itself not counted) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 24.12.2026. 24 December is a Thursday and, per the stated rules, 24 December is treated as a normal working day (not a public holiday) in NRW, so no further shift under § 193 BGB / § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.

warnings: This document is explicitly labelled 'Musterausgabe' (sample issue) and uses obviously fictitious names, addresses and a placeholder bank name ('Landesmusterbank'), suggesting it may be a template rather than a genuine Bescheid; verify the real sender's identity and contact details before relying on this.
